text: 😮 How Anthropic Made Claude's Apps 3x Faster in Two Weeks A grab bag of performance lessons from a sprint that cut p75 'time-to-typeable' from 3.1s to 0.55s. Em dashes (the irony!) pushed V8 onto a slower regex path, a stray location.reload() caused half a million hidden reloads a day, and more. Wang, Attard, and G (Anthropic)

CHALLENGE const arr = [1, 2, 3]; const log = []; const result = arr.map((x, i) => { if (i === 0) arr.push(4); log.push(x); return x * 2; }); console.log(result.join(','), log.join(','), arr.join(','));

CHALLENGE class Counter { #count = 0; static #instances = 0; constructor() { Counter.#instances++; } #increment() { this.#count++; } incrementAndGet() { this.#increment(); return this.#count; } static get total() { return Counter.#instances; } } class SpecialCounter extends Counter { incrementAndGet() { return super.incrementAndGet() * 2; } } const c1 = new Counter(); const c2 = new SpecialCounter(); console.log(`${c1.incrementAndGet()} ${c2.incrementAndGet()} ${Counter.total}`);

CHALLENGE const message = 'a 😀 bc'; const codePoints = [...message]; const combined = { raw: message.length, points: codePoints.length, second: codePoints[1] }; console.log(combined.raw, combined.points, combined.second);
